**Finding submitted: deviation (LD), confidence 0.9.**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 7.6 (p0032) — the only Customer-payable liquidated amount in the document. Searches for liquidated damages, penalties, early-termination/minimum fees, dependency mechanics, and termination payment obligations returned no other hits; § 7.3 (disputed amounts) and § 21.1 (mutual cap) do not create or cure a Customer LD.
- **Why it fails:** USD 25,000 per day accrues for *any* dependency delay, with no materiality threshold and no ceiling, so it breaches the fallback (early-termination fee capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount) and can exceed remaining contract value — walk-away territory.
- **Cure (preferred, one operation):** replaced the charging language in 7.6 with "Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement." No retained formula, instalment, or cross-reference to 7.6 survives, so the prohibition is unconditional and nothing dangles.
